jobs.title: Junior-Berater*in im Sektorvorhaben „Antikorruption und Integrität"
jobs.reason: A genuine entry-level ("Junior") role whose research, policy-drafting (Sachstände, Stellungnahmen) and stakeholder work fit the candidate's strengths, and the required degree in political science and German/English fluency are met; the human-rights angle is a plus. It sits in adjacent governance/development policy rather than the core mission, and the essential subject knowledge in anti-corruption, climate and first practical experience in international cooperation is a partial gap that the candidate only weakly covers, holding the score to the middle of the "good" band.
